detail_zh.lead: 光面写真相纸适用于需要光泽表面效果的海报、促销画面和室内展示项目。
highlights: 默认使用爱普生兼容替代墨水；可选爱普生原装墨水，价格增加USD 5/m²
默认覆100gsm PVC冷裱膜，黄底离型纸；可选亮膜或哑膜
applications: 零售门店及销售点展示
finishing: 默认100gsm PVC冷裱膜（黄底离型纸），可选亮膜或哑膜
默认卷装并使用硬质纸筒包装
覆膜材料本身具有高透明、低气味、耐水、耐腐蚀、耐磨、耐刮擦及抗UV等特性；这些描述针对覆膜材料，不代表成品具有未经测试的户外使用寿命。
delivery: 标准包装：卷装，内置硬质纸筒
通常约2天完成生产，工厂备货及发出一般不超过一周
海运运输约40天，实际时效取决于航线、货代及清关
detail_zh.artwork: 请提供印刷文件、成品尺寸、数量、卷装或裁切要求及目的地。生产前可核对文件尺寸和出血设置。
detail_zh.brief: 请提供材料类型、宽度、数量或面积、是否覆膜、油墨选择、包装要求及收货国家/地区。
detail_zh.caveat: 最低起订条件为100平方米，或订单货值超过USD 2,000（满足其中一项即可）。价格为参考单价，运费、税费及最终交付时间需按目的地和运输方案确认。

detail_en.lead: Gloss photo paper is suited to posters, promotional graphics and indoor displays where a glossy surface appearance is preferred.
highlights: Epson-compatible replacement ink is standard; original Epson ink is available at an additional USD 5/m²
Standard cold lamination uses 100 gsm PVC film with a yellow release liner; gloss or matte finish available
finishing: Standard 100 gsm PVC cold lamination with yellow release liner; gloss or matte finish
Standard roll packing with a rigid paper tube inside

The lamination film itself is described as highly transparent, low-odour, water-resistant, corrosion-resistant, abrasion-resistant, scratch-resistant and UV-resistant. These properties describe the film, not an untested outdoor service life for the finished print.
delivery: Standard roll packing with a rigid paper tube inside
Carton packing can be discussed as an alternative
Production typically takes around 2 days; factory preparation and dispatch generally take no more than one week
Sea freight is approximately 40 days; actual transit depends on route, forwarder and customs arrangements
detail_en.artwork: Please provide print-ready artwork, finished dimensions, quantity, roll or cut-sheet requirements and destination. File dimensions and bleed can be checked before production.
detail_en.brief: Please specify the media type, width, quantity or area, lamination, ink option, packing requirements and destination country or region.
detail_en.caveat: MOQ is 100 m², or an order goods value above USD 2,000; either condition is sufficient. Prices are reference rates. Freight, duties and final delivery dates must be confirmed for the destination and shipping arrangement.
